exam_scheme.note: NISM certification examinations are computer-based testing (CBT) modules mandated by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) under Regulation 3 of the SEBI (Certification of Associated Persons in the Securities Markets) Regulations, 2007. Candidate registrations and test delivery occur year-round across designated NISM test centers nationwide or via remote proctoring.

competition_benchmarks.note: NISM regulatory certifications serve as non-competitive statutory qualification tests rather than limited-seat recruitments. As such, notified vacancies and selectivity ratios are not applicable; candidates who secure the prescribed benchmark percentage are granted statutory certification valid for 3 years.
